t: What Tool Wear Database Is All About
title: What Tool Wear Database Is All About
description: Tool wear is measured in minutes of cut: Taylor's tool life equation (VT^n = C) trades speed for life; flank wear (0.3mm typical limit), crater wear, and chipping are the modes. Coatings (TiN, AlTiN) multiply life; coolant extends it; the right speeds/feeds per material are the baseline. Track wear vs parameters — the database that pays for the tooling. This database is the complete tool wear record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
